item.title: US and Iran pause strikes for second day as diplomatic efforts continue
item.description: The United States and Iran have paused military strikes for a second consecutive day, marking the first sustained halt in hostilities since the US began a nightly bombing campaign against Iran nearly two weeks ago. No US attacks on Iran were reported on Saturday or Sunday, and Iran’s army…

item.title: Oil prices tumble, stock futures rally as U.S. and Iran pause attacks
item.description: U.S. stock-index futures rallied and oil prices tumbled on Sunday after the United States and Iran took a pause from fighting, according to multiple market reports. The moves come as Wall Street prepares for a busy week that includes the Federal Reserve’s policy meeting and key earnings reports…

item.title: Zelenskyy to meet UK PM Burnham as US-Ukraine air ceasefire talks reported
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy is set to meet UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham on Monday in what will be Burnham's first international visit since taking office a week ago, Downing Street said. item.title: Wildfires force mass evacuations in France and Spain, disrupt Tour de France
item.description: Wildfires raging across southwestern France and parts of Spain have forced more than 300,000 people to evacuate their homes, authorities said Sunday, as the blazes disrupted the final stage of the Tour de France and caused widespread damage. In France, some 55,000 people were evacuated overnight…

item.title: Berlin Pride attack suspect Abdul Ballout shot dead by police
item.description: Berlin police shot and killed Abdul Ballout, the 21-year-old German citizen of Lebanese heritage suspected of carrying out a van-ramming and stabbing attack at a Berlin Pride event on Saturday evening, ending a 24-hour manhunt. item.title: Pogacar wins fifth Tour de France title
item.description: Tadej Pogacar won the Tour de France for a record-equalling fifth time on Sunday, crossing the line on Paris' Champs-Elysees in the peloton to join Jacques Anquetil, Eddy Merckx, Bernard Hinault and Miguel Indurain as the most successful male riders in the race's history.
